credits.title: R... Rajkumar
credits.overview: Rajkumar, an aimless youth, works for a drug baron and is sent to kill a rival dealer. His life is changed forever when he meets Chanda, and has no idea she is the adopted daughter of the man he is supposed to kill.

credits.title: OMG: Oh My God!
credits.overview: A shopkeeper takes God to court when his shop is destroyed by an earthquake.

credits.title: Tilak
credits.overview: Chanda, a notorious dacoit, decides to give up her outlaw ways and soon falls in love with Vijay, a police officer. However, her past soon catches up with her in a big way.
